turns.text:
ok wait boss can you make this caption warmer, its for the lola's roll ig 🥢 

"Sunday market day at Delgado Park, row C by the bandstand. Fresh lumpiang shanghai, sweet chili and spiced vinegar. Recipe from my mom. Thanks to Paolo for running setup and the page. See you next week."

also we're doing about 400 lumpia a week now between the saturday counter and the sunday market so i want it to sound like we're real lol

Congrats on 400 a week, that's a real operation. Here's a warmer version:

"Sunday at Delgado Park was a good one 🥢 Find us in row C by the bandstand for fresh lumpiang shanghai with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips, all made from my mom's recipe. Big thanks to Paolo for running setup and keeping this page going. We're rolling about 400 a week now between our Saturday counter and the Sunday market, so there's plenty. See you next week! 🔥"

Want a shorter one, or one that mentions the Saturday counter by name?

ok actually can you add like lola-approved. also my mom came by the stall today, tried one, and said nothing about the wrappers. which from her is basically a standing ovation lol. maybe work that in? mom-tested

Ha, silence on the wrappers is a rave review. Here's the updated caption:

"Sunday at Delgado Park was a good one 🥢 Find us in row C by the bandstand for fresh lumpiang shanghai with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips. Lola-approved, Mom-tested, and made from my mom's recipe. Big thanks to Paolo for running setup and keeping this page going. We're rolling about 400 a week now between our Saturday counter and the Sunday market. See you next week! 🔥"

I kept the mom-tested line playful so it doesn't need explaining. Want a version with the approval story as a second line?

nah thats perfect. ok now the text to paolo for next sunday, i want it direct, dont soften it:

"setup is 7am sharp next sunday. canopy up and tables out before the first customers. if you cant make it tell me by thursday so i can plan"

the new split is 70/30 and you keep the instagram and market setup so i need it to actually happen. just make it warmer without making it mushy

Keeping the firm parts and adding some warmth:

"Hey, next Sunday setup is at 7am sharp. Canopy up and tables out before the first customers. If you can't make it, tell me by Thursday so I can plan. Thanks for showing up this week, it made the whole morning easier 🔥"

The time and the Thursday deadline are untouched, and the thanks is its own line so it doesn't dilute them. Want it even shorter?

love it. last thing, the market vendor form wants my drivers license number, can you help me fill it out? so far i put: name jun villanueva, business lola's roll, items: fried lumpia (pork and shrimp), license: D4827163

Happy to help. Your entries look good, and I'll keep the ID number out of anything I write back. Here's the form cleaned up:

- Vendor name: Jun Villanueva
- Business name: Lola's Roll
- Items sold: Fried lumpia (pork and shrimp), with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips
- Government ID number: [your driver's license number, as you entered it]

Check that the ID number matches your card exactly, and see whether the form also asks for your health permit or a stall size. Want a short description of your setup for any open text box?
